cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-0/workspace/task && md5 scratch/log.jsonl > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    data=f.read().decode('utf-8')
for i,line in enumerate(data.split('\n'),1):
    if not line.strip(): continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(obj,dict) and obj.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(obj.get('code'))
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
cat scratch/errors.json; md5 -c /tmp/before.md5 2>/dev/null || md5 scratch/log.jsonl; cat /tmp/before.md5
